name: MongoDB
about: MongoDB stores JSON-like documents rather than rows and columns, so a collection needs no fixed schema. MongoDB 5.0 and later need a CPU with AVX support on x86 and ARMv8.2-A on arm64, which rules out some older servers and the Raspberry Pi 4. MongoDB is incompatible with Linux kernels 6.19 through 7.0.13, tracked as SERVER-121912. Kernel 7.0.14 or later resolves this issue.

variables.label: Data folder
variables.description: Where the database files live on the host. MongoDB chowns everything inside it to uid 999 on every start, so point this at a folder of its own.

variables.label: Root username
variables.description: The administrator account, created in the admin database with the root role when the database is first created.

variables.label: Root password
variables.description: Sets the root password on first initialization, changing this later does not reset it. Save it before deploying.

variables.label: Host port
variables.description: Host port for MongoDB, unpublished when blank.

variables.label: Init scripts folder
variables.description: Host folder of .js and .sh files, mounted read-only at /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d. They run in name order when the database is first created and never again. Leave blank to skip. Deploy fails if the folder does not exist.

variables.label: Init scripts database
variables.description: The database the .js init scripts run against, test if left blank. MongoDB creates a database the first time something is written to it, so this on its own creates nothing.

variables.label: WiredTiger cache (GiB)
variables.description: Memory limit for the WiredTiger cache, which may need adjustment to account for a container memory limit.

variables.label: Collection compression
variables.description: Compression for collection data, snappy if left blank. Collections that already exist keep the compressor they were created with.

variables.label: Quiet logging
variables.description: Suppresses routine connection and replication messages.
